I was at a friend's birthday and someone gave me a tab. I didn't know what to expect and at first it was super fun, I danced and everything looked amazing. Then I started overthinking about whether people were judging me, and I hid in the bathroom for an hour. A friend came and talked me down. After that it was okay again. Long term I'd say I learned to be more careful and that I care too much about what people think of me, which I'm working on, and I also learned who my real friends are. I don't regret it, but next time I'd prepare properly and choose the people more carefully.
